| extend joinID = toupper(id)
| project joinID
| join kind=inner (
    resources

    | extend machineId = toupper(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))

| summarize Instances = count() by Edition

content.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines" and properties['detectedProperties']['mssqldiscovered'] == "true" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup})) and tostring(tags['sqlmanaged']) != 'false'
| extend
    joinID = toupper(id), ConnectedMachineProxy=parse_json(properties.agentConfiguration.proxyUrl)
| join kind= leftouter  (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions" and name == "WindowsAgent.SqlServer" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/extensions'))), SQLExtensionStatus = parse_json(properties).provisioningState, esuLastUpdate = todatetime(parse_json(properties).settings.esuLastUpdatedTimestamp), LicenseType=parse_json(properties.settings.LicenseType), Version = tostring(properties.typeHandlerVersion)
    | project machineId, name, SQLExtensionStatus, esuLastUpdate, LicenseType, Version
) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
| join kind= leftouter  (
    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/extensions" and name == "AzureMonitorWindowsAgent" and ('*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or resourceGroup in ({ResourceGroup}))
    | extend machineId = toupper(substring(id, 0, indexof(id, '/extensions'))), MonitoringAgentStatus = parse_json(properties).provisioningState, MonitoringAgentProxy=parse_json(properties.settings.proxy.address)
    | project machineId, name, MonitoringAgentStatus, MonitoringAgentProxy
) on $left.joinID == $right.machineId
| project id, Connected = tostring(properties.status), LicenseType
, SQLExtensionStatus = iif(isnull(SQLExtensionStatus), "Missing", tostring(SQLExtensionStatus)), Version
, MonitoringAgentStatus = iif(isnull(MonitoringAgentStatus), "Missing", tostring(MonitoringAgentStatus))
, ProxyConsistencyCheck = iff(iif(isempty(tostring(MonitoringAgentProxy)), "No", tostring(MonitoringAgentProxy)) == iif(isempty(tostring(ConnectedMachineProxy)), "No", tostring(ConnectedMachineProxy)), true, false), esuLastUpdate, resourceGroup = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/',resourceGroup), subscriptionId = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId)
| extend ErrorsCheck = iff(Connected=="Connected", 0,1) + iif(tostring(LicenseType)=="Paid",0,1) + iif(tostring(SQLExtensionStatus)=="Succeeded",0,1) + iif(tostring(MonitoringAgentStatus)=="Succeeded",0,1) + iif(ProxyConsistencyCheck==true,0,1)
| where ErrorsCheck >= {ErrorsCheck}
| order by id asc

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (InsightsMetrics
    | where Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | project TimeGenerated, Val, _ResourceId),
    (Perf
    | where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | project TimeGenerated, Val = CounterValue, _ResourceId)
| extend Computer = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(Val), 1), PeakCPU = round(max(Val), 1), P95CPU = round(percentile(Val, 95), 1) by _ResourceId, Computer
| order by PeakCPU desc

let readData = union isfuzzy=true
    (InsightsMetrics
    | where Namespace == "LogicalDisk" and Name == "ReadLatencyMs"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | summarize AvgReadLatencyMs = round(avg(Val), 2) by _ResourceId),
    (Perf
    | where ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "Avg. Disk sec/Read"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | summarize AvgReadLatencyMs = round(avg(CounterValue) * 1000, 2) by _ResourceId);
let writeData = union isfuzzy=true
    (InsightsMetrics
    | where Namespace == "LogicalDisk" and Name == "WriteLatencyMs"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | summarize AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(avg(Val), 2) by _ResourceId),

    | where TimeGenerated > ago({CpuTimeRange})
    | summarize AvgWriteLatencyMs = round(avg(CounterValue) * 1000, 2) by _ResourceId);
readData
| join kind=fullouter writeData on _ResourceId
| project _ResourceId = coalesce(_ResourceId, _ResourceId1), AvgReadLatencyMs = coalesce(AvgReadLatencyMs, 0.0), AvgWriteLatencyMs = coalesce(AvgWriteLatencyMs, 0.0)
| extend Computer = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| order by AvgWriteLatencyMs desc

---
## Azure SQL VM Storage Best Practices

| Recommendation | Why | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| **Separate data, log, and tempdb onto different disks** | Prevents I/O contention between read-heavy data, sequential log writes, and tempdb | High |
| **Use Premium SSD or Ultra Disk for production** | Guaranteed IOPS/throughput with low latency (<1ms for Ultra) | High |
| **Enable ReadOnly caching on data disks** | Serves repeated reads from host cache, reducing disk I/O | High |
| **No caching on transaction log disks** | Log writes are sequential and don't benefit from caching | Medium |
| **Use disk striping (Storage Spaces) for IOPS aggregation** | Combines IOPS/throughput of multiple disks | High |
| **Set 64KB NTFS allocation unit size** | Matches SQL Server extent size for optimal I/O alignment | Medium |
| **Enable instant file initialization** | Eliminates zero-fill on data file growth, reducing wait times | Medium |
| **Right-size VM for expected IOPS** | VM size caps max cached/uncached IOPS regardless of disk config | High |
| **Monitor disk queue length** | Queue >2 per disk sustained indicates I/O bottleneck | Medium |
| **Disk latency <10ms for OLTP workloads** | Higher latency degrades query performance | High |

> **Reference:** [Azure SQL VM Storage Configuration Best Practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-sql/virtual-machines/windows/performance-guidelines-best-practices-storage)

### Target Readiness and Estimated Cost
**Readiness is an assessment result, not approval to start migration.** It evaluates discovered instance/database compatibility and whether a target configuration can satisfy the observed resource requirements.

- **Ready**: no blocking target issue was reported. Review warnings, application dependencies, security, connectivity, downtime, and validation before migration.
- **Ready with conditions**: the base recommendation is Ready, but target-specific compatibility findings need review.
- **Not ready**: the assessment found a compatibility or sizing/configuration reason that prevents recommending this target. Open **Assessment Issues** for evidence and remediation.
- **Unknown**: the assessment is incomplete, stale, or did not return enough data.

**Returned blocking findings** and **Returned warnings** count target-specific assessment records across both the SQL Server instance and its user databases. Blocking findings explain compatibility problems; warnings explain **Ready with conditions** and do not make the blocker count greater than 0. If Azure reports **Not ready** but returns no detailed blocker, the workbook says that the reason is unavailable instead of treating 0 as proof of readiness. Open **Assessment Issues** and the target tab for the affected objects and remediation details.

For **SQL Managed Instance** and **SQL Database**, there is no separate Windows Server license charge. The selected PaaS service rate includes the SQL license entitlement unless **Azure Hybrid Benefit (AHB)** applies; the assessment's `sqlLicenseCost` is an informational breakout already included in its compute/service total and must not be added again. For **SQL Server on Azure VM**, SQL and Windows license fields are separate charge components and are added to compute, storage, and IOPS in **Estimated Total $/mo**. These are assessment estimates, not invoice totals; backup storage, network transfer, support, and other ancillary charges can be excluded.

SQL Database sizing is calculated per database, so the instance aggregate might contain only a partial SKU description. SQL Managed Instance and SQL VM normally have an instance-level recommendation. **Not returned by assessment** means that this resource payload contains no SKU value; it does not mean that the target is unavailable. Review the target tab and the native Azure Arc assessment for per-database recommendations and recommendation reasoning.

    resources
    | where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
    | extend parentMarker = indexof(tolower(id), "/databases/")
    | where parentMarker > 0 and substring(tolower(id), 0, parentMarker) == tolower("{selectedServerId}")

It is not a confidence score. **3-year reservation** means reserved pricing is assumed instead of pay-as-you-go. **Azure Hybrid Benefit** means the estimate assumes eligible existing licenses are applied; it does not confirm license eligibility. A separate custom discount is omitted when it is 0 or not applicable; any nonzero discount is shown within **Compute Pricing Assumption**.

### SQL Database Readiness
SQL Database is assessed **per user database**. The instance is **Not ready** when one or more databases have a blocking SQL Database compatibility issue; databases that are offline, restoring, or otherwise unavailable can be **Unknown**. The instance-level `numberOfServerBlockerIssues` does not count these database blockers, which is why it can show 0 while the SQL Database target is Not ready.

The rollup and database inventory below are calculated from each database resource's `properties.migration.assessment.targetReadiness.azureSqlDatabase`. **Issue** findings block that database. **Warning** findings require review but do not by themselves make it Not ready.     | extend MachineId = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/patchassessmentresults/')[0]),
        IsSummary = type endswith '/patchassessmentresults'
    | summarize AssessmentRows = make_list_if(pack('Id', tolower(id), 'Properties', properties), IsSummary, 1048576),
        PatchRows = make_list_if(pack('Id', tolower(id), 'Properties', properties), not(IsSummary), 1048576),
        PatchRecordCount = countif(not(IsSummary)) by MachineId
) on MachineId
| extend PatchDetailsTruncated = coalesce(PatchRecordCount, 0) > coalesce(array_length(PatchRows), 0) or array_length(PatchRows) > 2000
| extend AssessmentRows = iff(coalesce(array_length(AssessmentRows), 0) > 0, AssessmentRows, dynamic([null]))
| mv-expand AssessmentRow = AssessmentRows limit 2000
| extend AssessmentId = tostring(AssessmentRow.Id), AssessmentTime = todatetime(AssessmentRow.Properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
    AssessmentStartedAt = todatetime(AssessmentRow.Properties.startDateTime),
    AssessmentStatus = tostring(AssessmentRow.Properties.status), OS = tostring(AssessmentRow.Properties.osType),
    RebootPending = tobool(AssessmentRow.Properties.rebootPending), AssessmentErrors = tostring(AssessmentRow.Properties.errorDetails),
    ReportedClassificationCounts = tostring(AssessmentRow.Properties.availablePatchCountByClassification)
| summarize arg_max(coalesce(AssessmentTime, datetime(1900-01-01)), *) by MachineId
| extend AssessmentCoverage = case(isempty(AssessmentId), 'No assessment returned',
    AssessmentStatus !~ 'Succeeded', 'Assessment not successful',
    isnull(AssessmentTime), 'Assessment time unknown',
    AssessmentTime < ago(24h), 'Stale (over 24 hours)', 'Fresh (within 24 hours)')
| extend PatchRows = iff(coalesce(array_length(PatchRows), 0) > 0, PatchRows, dynamic([null]))
| mv-expand PatchRow = PatchRows limit 2000
| extend PatchResourceId = tostring(PatchRow.Id),
    PatchAssessmentId = tostring(split(tostring(PatchRow.Id), '/softwarepatches/')[0]),
    PatchUpdatedAt = todatetime(PatchRow.Properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
    PatchName = tostring(PatchRow.Properties.patchName), KbId = tostring(PatchRow.Properties.kbId),
    Version = tostring(PatchRow.Properties.version), Classifications = PatchRow.Properties.classifications,
    Severity = tostring(PatchRow.Properties.msrcSeverity), RebootBehavior = tostring(PatchRow.Properties.rebootBehavior)
| extend PrimaryClassification = case(Classifications has 'Critical', 'Critical',
    Classifications has 'Security', 'Security',
    isnotempty(tostring(Classifications[0])), tostring(Classifications[0]), 'Unclassified')

    and PatchAssessmentId == AssessmentId
    and isnotnull(AssessmentStartedAt) and isnotnull(AssessmentTime) and isnotnull(PatchUpdatedAt)
    and PatchUpdatedAt >= AssessmentStartedAt and PatchUpdatedAt <= AssessmentTime

    Security = countif(PatchValid and PrimaryClassification == 'Security'),
    Critical = countif(PatchValid and PrimaryClassification == 'Critical')
    by MachineId, Machine, MachineResourceGroup, HostType, OS, AssessmentCoverage,
        AssessmentStatus, AssessmentTime, RebootPending, AssessmentErrors, ReportedClassificationCounts, PatchDetailsTruncated
| summarize ['SQL Hosts'] = count(), ['Fresh Assessments'] = countif(AssessmentCoverage == 'Fresh (within 24 hours)'),
    ['Stale Assessments'] = countif(AssessmentCoverage == 'Stale (over 24 hours)'),
    ['No Assessment Returned'] = countif(AssessmentCoverage == 'No assessment returned'),
    ['Other Assessment Problems'] = countif(AssessmentCoverage in ('Assessment not successful', 'Assessment time unknown')),
    ['Returned Missing Patches'] = sum(ReturnedMissingPatches),
    ['Security Patches'] = sum(Security), ['Critical Patches'] = sum(Critical),
    ['Reboot Pending (reported)'] = countif(RebootPending == true),
    ['Hosts With Truncated Details'] = countif(PatchDetailsTruncated == true)

content.query:
securityresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.security/assessments'
| where tostring(properties.metadata.recommendationCategory) in~ ('SoftwareUpdate', 'ServiceUpgrade')
| extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceDetails.Id)),
    Additional = parse_json(tostring(properties.additionalData))
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type in~ ('microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines', 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances', 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines')
    | where type !~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines' or tostring(properties.detectedProperties.mssqldiscovered) =~ 'true'
    | extend MachineId = tolower(case(
        type =~ 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines', tostring(properties.virtualMachineResourceId),
        type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances', tostring(properties.containerResourceId), id))
    | where MachineId matches regex '^/subscriptions/[^/]+/resourcegroups/[^/]+/providers/microsoft[.](compute/virtualmachines|hybridcompute/machines)/[^/]+$'
    | extend Machine = tostring(split(MachineId, '/')[8]),
        MachineResourceGroup = tostring(split(MachineId, '/')[4]),
        HostType = iff(MachineId contains '/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/', 'Arc SQL host', 'Azure SQL VM')
    | where '*' in ({ResourceGroup}) or MachineResourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroup})
    | summarize by MachineId, Machine, MachineResourceGroup, HostType
) on MachineId
| extend Cves = parse_json(tostring(Additional.CvesDetails))
| mv-expand Cve = Cves
| where isnotempty(tostring(Cve.CveId))
| extend Software = tostring(Additional.SoftwareName),
    Vendor = tostring(Additional.SoftwareVendor),
    DetectedVersion = tostring(Additional.DetectedSoftwareVersions),
    Assessment = tostring(properties.displayName),
    CVE = tostring(Cve.CveId),
    Severity = tostring(Cve.Severity),
    FixStatus = tostring(Cve.FixStatus),
    CVEFixedVersion = tostring(Cve.FixedVersion),
    RecommendedFixedVersion = tostring(Additional.FixedVersion),
    MaxCVSS = todouble(Additional.MaxCvssScore)
| summarize Machines = dcount(MachineId),
    MachineNames = make_set(Machine, 25),
    HostTypes = make_set(HostType, 5),
    ResourceGroups = make_set(MachineResourceGroup, 25),
    DetectedVersions = make_set(DetectedVersion, 25),
    Assessments = make_set(Assessment, 10),
    CVEFixedVersions = make_set(CVEFixedVersion, 10),
    RecommendedFixedVersions = make_set(RecommendedFixedVersion, 10),
    MaxCVSS = max(MaxCVSS)
    by Software, Vendor, CVE, Severity, FixStatus
| extend NVD = strcat('https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/', CVE)
| order by Severity asc, Software asc, CVE asc
